attributionPitfallsV123.finding: A red/green in-game screenshot was called Epic Exclusive by some commenters, but Noktrum identified the posted picture as Shatter Fracture; poster acknowledged that identification. It does not authenticate Epic Exclusive or Bleak pixels.
attributionPitfallsV123.forbiddenInference: Do not synthesize an Epic Exclusive or Shatter Bleak texture solely by copying the green/red screen colors.

attributionPitfallsV123.finding: Patch 2.19 lists Ogre under Predator Mask Tint for Alpha Predator, not as a Predator Armor Tint. A similarly named armor shader still needs separate evidence.
attributionPitfallsV123.forbiddenInference: Do not borrow the mask Ogre color or material as armor 1:1 proof.

attributionPitfallsV123.finding: An actual JH87 customization screenshot shows SAMURAI ARMOR / HUNTER ARMOR selected, not skin-pattern Wasteland, Badland, Quagmire or Undergrowth.
attributionPitfallsV123.forbiddenInference: A JH87 armory screenshot is not proof of any of four exclusive skin shaders.

attributionPitfallsV123.finding: Official version 3.0 patch fixed coloration across certain skin/armor tints; a community texture experiment reports UV incompatibility for Feral on female meshes. The latter is a community report, not original developer UV data.
attributionPitfallsV123.forbiddenInference: Do not declare one generated planar material seamless or 1:1 across six morphologies by default.

attributionPitfallsV123.finding: A July 2021 PHG customization bug report notes Elder Ancient, Relic, Primeval and Stoic skin tints, and separately says equivalent Elder predlock variations were NOT available at that time. Do not create authentic-labeled Elder predlocks just because the skin shader names exist.
attributionPitfallsV123.forbiddenInference: Do not infer Elder predlock material variants from similarly named Elder skin shader entries.
